summary: Linn County, OR lookout: a 1949 skid house, a 1959 two-story cab, ended by 1969 or 1970 depending on source; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Two-story L-4 cab built in 1959 as a 14 x 14 lookout house atop an enclosed garage; it replaced a 1949 skid-mounted house with cupola
facts.status_note: Dismantled in 1969 (Forest Lookouts page) or removed or destroyed in 1970 (register, firelookout.com); no source describes the site today
facts.agency: Santiam Lumber Company (cooperator); Oregon Dept. of Forestry named on the register

Santiam Lumber Company built a 14 x 14 lookout house atop an enclosed garage; the register calls it a two-story L-4 cab

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Lookouts page says the lookout was dismantled in 1969 with usable material moved to Green Peter; the register says it was removed in 1970; firelookout.com says it was destroyed in 1970. Not reconciled; the story gives both dates.
The register and firelookout.com name Santiam Lumber Company with the Oregon Dept. of Forestry; the Forest Lookouts page calls Santiam Lumber Company a cooperator and does not name the Department.

notes_for_editor: No source describes the site today, so no access fact is recorded. The 1969 vs 1970 end date is unresolved and both are kept. The register's two-story L-4 cab and the Forest Lookouts page's 14 x 14 lookout house atop a garage (both 1959) appear to describe the same structure; that link is an inference, not stated by one source. The Albany Democrat-Herald items are quoted secondhand on the Forest Lookouts page; the original newspaper pages were not read.
